themes.title: Nvidia reinstates Huang; $1tn rally, Trump in middle
themes.summary: Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO eleven days after his resignation, triggering a historic one-day rally that added nearly a trillion dollars in market value and lifted the entire AI complex. The unprecedented move involved lobbying by Silicon Valley leaders, reported White House support, and immediate questions from lawmakers and bearish commentators about governance, national-security exposure, and what it signals about Washington's leverage over chip supply.
themes.angle: For GCC boards: CEO succession is now a national-security variable; the Huang saga is a governance case study, not just a market story.

themes.title: UAE agentic AI wave: du-RADX, Mira, governance guide
themes.summary: A cluster of UAE signals shows agentic AI moving from pilots to policy: telecom du and Dubai's RADX are exploring agentic AI for government and business, the University of Dubai and AIJRF published what is billed as the first Arab guide on agentic AI governance, and a national AI assistant 'Mira' is slated for next year.
themes.angle: The UAE is building the governance layer for agents before the products scale — a differentiator regional regulators can export.

themes.title: DeepMind agents build verified quantum algorithms
themes.summary: Google DeepMind and Google Quantum AI used AI agent teams with formal verification (Lean) to discover faster quantum algorithms, with one subroutine reported ~290x faster. It is a concrete example of agents driving frontier research with machine-checkable results.
themes.angle: Formal verification is the under-appreciated enabler for deploying agents in regulated work — a pattern GCC enterprises should copy.

themes.title: Abu Dhabi–Saudi sovereign capital rides AI
themes.summary: Sovereign-backed AI money keeps moving: PIF-backed HUMAIN secured $667m for Saudi AI infrastructure, Abu Dhabi's Mubadala saw its US equities book fall in the AI selloff, and Gulf News tallied Abu Dhabi's AI ledger from data centres to a ~$20b gain on Anthropic.
themes.angle: GCC allocators are now exposed to AI volatility through listed equities — diversification into direct AI assets is the strategic read.

themes.title: US blacklists Megaspeed, Alibaba unit after Nvidia scandal
themes.summary: The Trump administration blacklisted Megaspeed International — the Singapore firm at the centre of the Nvidia spy scandal — barring it from buying advanced AI chips, and separately blacklisted an Alibaba-owned company. FT argues the episode shows how little leverage Washington holds over Beijing.
themes.angle: Export controls are tightening on intermediaries, not just countries — compliance exposure now runs through corporate entities and subsidiaries.

themes.angle: The AI economy is producing real GDP but frothy equity — the distinction matters for allocators.

themes.title: OpenAI seeks lab limits pact, ships Shirudo

themes.angle: Lab-led limits are the story to watch for GCC adopters: self-regulation is filling a governance vacuum.
